scripts.build:candidate-preview: tsc -b && vite build --mode candidate-preview --outDir dist/client && node scripts/prepare-candidate-preview-build.mjs
scripts.build:stage-a-candidate: tsc -b && vite build --mode stage-a-candidate --outDir dist/client && node scripts/prepare-stage-a-candidate-build.mjs
scripts.build:sites-200: tsc -b && vite build --mode sites-200 --outDir dist/client && node scripts/prepare-sites-200-build.mjs
scripts.check:contracts: npm run generate:contracts && npm run generate:sites-contracts && git diff --exit-code -- src/contracts/life-console.ts src/contracts/life-console-sites.ts
scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && vitest run && npm run test:python
scripts.test:contracts: npm run check:contracts && vitest run tests/contract
scripts.test:journal-contract: vitest run tests/journal/normalization-contract.test.ts && cd ../.. && python3 -m unittest tools.test_journal_normalization_contract -v
scripts.test:python: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/hub -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/packaging -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/local_agent -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests/e2e -p 'test_*.py'
